breathCueTheme.title: Мягкое дыхательное движение
breathCueTheme.behavior: tidal-tone-v2: duration-matched procedural phase buffers, without looping or playback-rate changes. Brighter rising inhale and darker falling exhale use rounded attacks and decay to silence. Hold markers last 320/400ms; natural breathing is silent. Runtime source is procedural-cue.ts; delivered masters are previews.
